source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'CLASS IX - ANNUAL EXAMINATION', 'MATHEMATICS', '(Two hours and a half)'; every page footer prints 'NP20 511' (recorded as paperCode) and 'This paper consists of 8 printed pages.' No year is printed; examYear 2020 is taken from the file name and folder. No overall maximum is printed (only 'SECTION A (40 Marks)' and 'SECTION B (40 Marks)'), so maxMarks is null. Section A: Questions 1-4 compulsory; Section B: attempt any four of Questions 5-11, so the pack's marks total exceeds 80. Page 3 (Questions 3 and 4) is a blurred scan: some values could not be read with certainty and are flagged. Page 8 carries an advertisement (WhatsApp/Paytm) that is not part of the paper and was ignored, as were handwritten ticks. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images (mathematical notation rebuilt from the images). Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
